messages:
maria: Heads-up — Q4 hosted-api capacity planning. Vendor lead times changed: vendor-A 6–10w, vendor-B 12–16w. We need additional capacity in region us-west1 by Nov 1 for holiday surge. Budget capex ~ $1.2M but procurement timeline is tight. Can infra team run buy/lease/cloud-burst scenarios with supply-delay baked in? Looking for GPU-hours, p95 latency risk, and cost delta.

raj: On it. What's the target peak throughput we want to guarantee? 2x baseline? 3x?

maria: Target = 2.5x baseline peak Q4 forecast. Baseline: 1200 v100-equivalent GPU-hours/day; peak target ~3000 GPU-hours/day for 2-week window.

dave: My quick take: hybrid. Buy long-lead 30% (to lower unit cost), lease 50% with rolling 6/12 month leases, keep 20% as cloud-burst (spot + reserved) for immediate headroom. But we need to simulate preemption risk for spot burst.

sophia: Important: spot/preemptible bursts thrash KV caches in the runtime right now. We measured 18% p95 increase under 40% preemption churn. If we rely on cloud-burst for >10% capacity, we should add cache warmup guards and graceful degradation policies.

maria: Noted. Also supply-chain risk: vendor-A says delivery ETA 6–10w but with 10% chance of extra 3w. Vendor-B is 12–16w with higher discount. So timeline variance matters.

raj: I'm running a small sim now. Command I used:
```
./sim_capacity.py --baseline 1200 --peak-mult 2.5 --supply-delay-weeks 8 --preempt-risk 0.2 --months 3
```
Should have numbers in ~30m.

ops-bot: [automated metrics] weekly-run: avg GPU util 67%, p95 latency 220ms, peak QPS 18k at 2026-10-05 18:02:34 UTC, weekly GPU-hours 8.4k.

dave: From procurement: leasing vendors can deliver within 2–4w if we accept annotated refurb units; new units are the 6–10w path. Also financing can flip capex to opex for lease-to-own.

sophia: Operational mitigation: reduce memory footprint per model by 15% via microsharding and kv-cache pinning — lets us fit ~8% more concurrent sessions per GPU. That's a software lever we should include in scenarios.

maria: Proposal draft: buy 25% (long-term), lease 55% (short-term rolling), software optimization to add 8% capacity, cloud-burst capped at 12% with conservative preempt risk. CFO ok with this mix if cost delta <5% vs buy-heavy. Thoughts?

raj: I'm +1 on that mix pending sim results. If sim shows <3% risk to p95 and cost within 6% then greenlight.

dave: Scheduling procurement sync. I need approval to start lease LOIs for 55% capacity by EOD Wed. 

sophia: I'll schedule a runtime test to validate microshard memory reductions and run a KV warmup experiment on staging next week.

maria: Cool. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve LOI. If you need to flag concerns, reply here.

raj: :thumbsup:

 dave: :thumbsup:

 sophia: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: creating ticket INFRA-7034 for procurement LOI and linking sims.

maria: Thanks — we'll reconvene after sims and the procurement LOI status. Keep updates here. End of thread.
